categories.label: Historical Week 7 validation audit
categories.summary: Week 7 projection grading: ATS 27-24-2 (52.9%), SU 34-19 (64.2%), and totals shadow 25-23 (52.1% on 48 tracked totals). Spread and totals validation remain HOLD.

items.title: Saturday slate
items.detail: 49 Saturday matchups had a usable model baseline and were graded: 24-23-2 ATS and 31-18 straight up. Charleston Southern-Clemson, The Citadel-Texas A&M and Elon-Stanford were excluded because the model had no baseline projection.

items.title: Totals shadow
items.detail: 44 Saturday games had a saved pre-kick total and graded 21-23. Combined with the four earlier Week 7 tracked totals, the totals-shadow record is 25-23. Missing pre-kick totals remain ungraded rather than being reconstructed after the result.

items.title: Release integrity
items.detail: These are projection grades against saved comparison numbers, not a wager ledger. Week 7 had no released bets, and the existing spread/totals HOLD gates are preserved after grading.

categories.label: Injuries & availability
categories.summary: Official team previews and the Sun Belt game-day report are captured for the Tuesday–Wednesday priority slate. Availability does not automatically clear role or impact QA.

items.title: Missouri State at Delaware
items.detail: Missouri State’s own preview documents Henry Belin IV’s recent start; Delaware’s opponent overview names Skyler Locklear. Delaware’s preview reports Minicucci missed two games and Tyler Bell started most recently. Tuesday starters remain unresolved.

items.title: South Alabama at Marshall
items.detail: Official Sun Belt game-day availability is captured. South Alabama has three game-time decisions; Marshall lists five unavailable players. Marshall’s recent three-QB rotation still needs a starter/role confirmation. Missing names on an injury report do not confirm health or starting roles.

items.title: Wednesday at Sam Houston
items.detail: The Oct. 20 Sam Houston preview supports Landyn Locke as the recent offensive baseline and documents two freshman OL starters in the prior two games. NM State’s recent primary QB is Adam Damante. Final Wednesday starter and availability confirmation remains pending.

categories.label: Weather & venue
categories.summary: Direct NWS hourly forecasts cover kickoff through four hours for all four Tuesday–Wednesday games. Source issue times and retrieval times are preserved separately.

items.title: Latest direct capture
items.detail: Forecasts were retrieved October 20 at approximately 4:18 PM ET. Nearby forecast grids are not on-field observations. The hourly API does not supply gust values; missing is not zero.

items.title: Final refresh pending
items.detail: These afternoon forecasts do not fulfill the final one-hour check. Weather remains a review item until the actual pregame window. No unvalidated weather point adjustment is applied.

categories.label: Line movement & market
categories.summary: Timestamped FanDuel and DraftKings observations remain separate from the frozen foundation and publication locks. See Week 8 status for saved quote timestamps.

items.title: Tuesday lock windows
items.detail: The configured 30-minute windows open at 6:30 PM ET for MTSU–FIU and Missouri State–Delaware, and 7:00 PM ET for South Alabama–Marshall. Official FIU advertising says 7:02 PM kickoff; the frozen 7:00 PM identity and earlier conservative cutoff remain intact.

items.title: Wednesday lock window
items.detail: NM State–Sam Houston opens at 7:30 PM ET Wednesday. No missing pregame observation may be backfilled after kickoff. Current observations do not establish local execution availability.

categories.label: Efficiency, SOS & rankings
categories.summary: No reproducible authorized Week 8 canonical projection is present. The frozen foundation is a prospective research shadow, and external benchmarks remain separate.

items.title: Source boundaries
items.detail: The Sagarin snapshot is preserved. Current official ESPN SP+ retrieval was blocked by verification. RefMetrics returned a stale Week 7 board, so no Week 8 assignment is inferred.

items.title: Promotion gate
items.detail: New efficiency, personnel, market, pace or other challenger features require validated evidence and explicit authorization before canonical use. A research projection cannot substitute for an authorized canonical release.

categories.label: Tempo, pace & matchup style
categories.summary: Pace and matchup style are research candidates. No new feature is promoted to the Week 8 canonical model.

items.title: Possession environment
items.detail: Pace and drive volume influence projected scoring opportunities and are especially important for totals.

items.title: Style interaction
items.detail: Run/pass tendencies, explosiveness and defensive disruption help identify matchup-specific friction.

categories.label: Travel, rest & scheduling
categories.summary: Tuesday and Wednesday are the current priority. Active Week 8 work stops before Friday, October 23.

items.title: Rest correction
items.detail: MTSU and FIU both played October 13: seven calendar days before this matchup. FIU’s recap publication date of October 14 is not its game date.

items.title: NM State trip
items.detail: NM State’s official preview describes 13 full days without a game and a 1,336-mile trip. Context is retained without an unvalidated manual adjustment.

categories.label: Coaching, transfers & depth
categories.summary: Depth-chart changes, transfer impact and coaching continuity are used to interpret whether team baselines remain representative.

items.title: Depth reconciliation
items.detail: Starter and replacement roles matter more than raw injury counts. Unknown roles remain conservative review items.

items.title: Roster change
items.detail: Transfer and coaching changes can change how quickly prior performance should be trusted, especially early in a season.

categories.label: Situational trends
categories.summary: Rivalry, bye, revenge and scheduling narratives are tracked as hypotheses, not standalone picks.

items.title: No trend-shopping
items.detail: Situational angles need prospective evidence before they can affect release status. Post-hoc patterns remain research notes.

items.title: Validation first
items.detail: A large model/market difference cannot override a HOLD validation state or incomplete game-level readiness.
